navLayoutHelp: Hero transparent: glass pill slides down after you leave the hero top; the transparent bar is anchored in the hero so it scrolls away with the slide. Home only; other pages use the fixed pill.
colorProfileHelp: Navy promotes deep blue as the main accent; cyan stays on buttons, navbar hovers, and CTAs.
bentoIconsHelp: Show or hide the icon div in each solution card.
bentoAppearanceHelp: Pastel mesh is the default full-bleed background. Mint + grid is the prior light CSS treatment (#f6fbff). Dark demo is the night section behind the cards (#05070b).
bentoPastelGlassHelp: Stronger frost improves type contrast on the mesh; airier settings show more of the section background.
heroStyleHelp: Light soft-sky backgrounds with slow drift. No photo carousel.
latticeTuningHelp: Only applies to the selected lattice (p5) style. Values are kept per style.
hexagonInfluenceHelp: How far the cursor pulls nearby dots.
hexagonAttractionHelp: How strongly dots move toward the cursor.
hexagonWaveHelp: How strong each ripple pulse scales and darkens dots.
hexagonDensifyHelp: How much near-cursor dots enlarge and darken.
hexagonLinkCountHelp: How many nearest dots connect to the cursor (3–6).
hexagonTrailLengthHelp: How many recent cursor samples brighten the path.
hexagonTrailBrightnessHelp: How bright the fading paint path becomes.
heroCopyHelp: Switch among the three existing hero messages.
heroCopy0: Set 1 — Design to Simplify + Twenty Years
heroFrostedGlassHelp: Frosted panel behind the hero title, lead, and CTA. On by default.
heroMintHelp: Soft fade from the hero into the bento background. Applies for Pastel mesh or Light mint (not Dark demo).
contactAlignHelp: Toggle between top and bottom alignment on desktop.
hideEnquiryHelp: Show or hide the navbar enquiry button.
utilityBarAtTopTitle: Hide utility bar at home top
utilityBarAtTopHelp: Desktop only: collapse the navy utility strip (phone, email, languages) while the home hero is at the top; scroll to show. Off = always visible (default).
navSpinHelp: Switch from clip swipe to the former horizontal spin effect.
festivalBarHelp: Show or hide the announcement banner at the top of the page.
